title: 花旗陈俊：中美科技竞争，AI与机器人成新焦点？
speaker: Chen Jun

segments.en: And then specifically on AI I mean I hear you that there are opportunities for both sides to agree on some of the safety risks but essentially these are two sides that fundamentally aren't willing to hold development.
segments.zh: 具体到AI，我听到你说双方有机会就一些安全风险达成一致，但本质上这两方从根本上不愿意停止发展。

segments.en: Yes so in related to tech maybe we need to separate the old tech and new tech in China so for all tech it was for example EV solar battery something like that which was developed 10 years ago.
segments.zh: 是的，关于科技，也许我们需要区分中国的旧科技和新科技。旧科技比如电动车、太阳能电池等，是10年前开发的。

segments.en: Well currently China is facing more criticism on the for example dumping overcapacity related to that but that would definitely be part of the negotiation how to reduce over trade deficit to other nations that is number one.
segments.zh: 目前中国在这方面面临更多批评，比如倾销和产能过剩，但这肯定是谈判的一部分，如何减少对其他国家的贸易逆差，这是第一点。

segments.en: And number two related to AI and humanoid robot and also about tech some other sectors like I said at the beginning the two nations I do not see any potential say possibility they will pace their cat packs so increasing their say investment in the future betting for the next top leader in the world would very likely to be the target for both nations.
segments.zh: 第二，关于AI和人形机器人以及其他科技领域，就像我一开始说的，两国我看不到任何同步限制的可能性，所以增加未来投入、押注下一个全球领先者很可能是两国的目标。

segments.en: And one more thing we do not see there is any AI or another technology entrepreneur from China participate in this meeting together with President Xi right so the details we will not be that much in this in this week.
segments.zh: 还有一点，我们没有看到任何中国AI或其他科技企业家与习主席一起参加这次会晤，所以本周细节不会太多。
